content.title: Pi Day Deals: Pizza Hut, Burger King and other chains offer pizza and dessert pie specials — check them ou
content.text: Pi day deals: Every year on March 14, food lovers across the United States find a delicious excuse to celebrate math. Known as Pi Day, the annual event honors the mathematical constant 3.14, and restaurants have turned it into a celebration of pies in every form imaginable.From pizza slices to dessert pies, eateries and food brands are rolling out special promotions to mark the occasion. Many restaurants are offering major discounts, limited-time bundles, and even free items for customers who stop by on the holiday.For 2026, dozens of restaurants, delivery services and grocery stores are joining the celebration. Whether you want a cheap pizza, a slice of pie or a discounted frozen meal, Pi Day deals are popping up almost everywhere. The information on the deals is sourced from TODAY and WRAL News.ALSO READ: New lead in Nancy Guthrie case as investigators question Mexican restaurant workersWhy is Pi Day celebrated with pizza and pie deals?Pi Day takes place every year on March 14, written numerically as 3/14, in recognition of the mathematical constant pi.In mathematics, pi (π) represents the ratio between the circumference of a circle and its diameter. The number is commonly shortened to 3.14, which is why March 14 has become the unofficial holiday honoring it.Over time, restaurants realized that the number also lends itself perfectly to food promotions. After all, both pies and pizzas are circular, making them the ideal symbol for the day.As a result, food chains and retailers across the country now celebrate Pi Day with discounted menu items, $3.14 specials and limited-time offers.There’s also another interesting historical coincidence tied to the date. Renowned physicist Albert Einstein was born on March 14, 1879.ALSO READ: Nancy Guthrie case: Former FBI agent says authorities are very close to making an arrest—who could it be?Pi Day Deals 2026Blaze PizzaBlaze Pizza is once again marking Pi Day with a familiar promotion.On March 14, 2026, customers who buy one Blaze Pizza 11-inch pizza can get another for $3.14. The offer is available in stores only and applies at participating locations.The promotion was shared on the company’s Facebook page and continues the brand’s tradition of celebrating the holiday with a pizza-focused deal.Burger KingBurger King is joining the Pi Day celebration with a dessert promotion aimed at rewards members.On March 14, 2026, customers can receive a free Hershey’s Sundae Pie or Cinnamon Apple Pie when they spend $3.14 or more through the Burger King app or website.The deal is part of the chain’s Perks Week promotion running from March 8 through March 14. During that week, rewards members can access a different free item with purchase each day.Domino’sDomino’s is also offering a major discount during the Pi Day period.According to the company website, Domino’s is promoting what it describes as its “best deal ever.” Customers can order any pizza with any toppings for $9.99, with a limit of seven toppings.The chain is also running another promotion that allows customers to choose any two participating menu items for $6.99 each, including select pizzas.Marco’s PizzaMarco’s Pizza has created a special Pi Day code for customers placing digital orders.On March 14, 2026, customers who buy a large or extra-large menu-priced pizza can add a medium one-topping pizza for $3.14.To redeem the offer, customers must enter the code PIDAY during online or app checkout. As with many Pi Day deals, the promotion is only available at participating locations.MOD PizzaMOD Pizza is offering several different promotions tied to Pi Day.Rewards members can receive $3.14 off the purchase of a MOD-size pizza when ordering through the app and entering the code IRRATIONAL at checkout.Additionally, 314 customers will receive their entire order for $3.14. The company is also providing a free Pi Day poster that fans can download.Papa JohnsPapa Johns is promoting multiple specials around the holiday.Among the offers are Papa Pairings, which allow customers to purchase participating items for $6.99 each when they buy two or more. This promotion includes select pizzas.The chain is also advertising a large one-topping carryout pizza for $7.99, along with additional store-specific deals available through its website.Pizza HutPizza Hut is running several different offers during the Pi Day celebration.Customers can access the chain’s $7 Deal Lovers promotion when purchasing two or more participating items. Carryout pizzas are also available starting at $10.Another featured option is the Big Dinner Box, which starts at $24.99 at participating locations.SheetzSheetz is extending its Pi Day celebration beyond just one day.The company stated, “Sheetz will celebrate National Pi Day (3/14) by offering customers specially priced $3.14 cheese or pepperoni pizza flatz. This special offer is available from National Pi Day (Saturday, March 14) through Friday, March 20, 2026. This promotion can only be redeemed through the Sheetz app. Customers must add the offer under the OFFERZ tab in the Sheetz app to redeem it at any of Sheetz’s 810+ locations,” according to the Sheetz PR folks.Speedway and 7-ElevenSpeedway and 7-Eleven stores are also participating in the Pi Day festivities.On March 13 and March 14, reward members can purchase a whole pizza for $3.14 either in stores or through the 7NOW Delivery app.Additional promotions include 31.4-cent Cinnamon Sugar Fried Pies, $1 7-Select Snack Pies and $3.14 quesadillas.The DurhamIn Durham, North Carolina, a local Pi Day event is taking place at The Durham.Starting at 2 p.m. on March 14, the hotel’s Coffee Bar will sell slices of pie for $3.14. The pies are made by Durham baker Phoebe Lawless.Customers can choose from Chocolate Chess, Lemon Chess or Buttermilk Sugar pie.GrouponShoppers in the Raleigh and Triangle areas may find additional pizza deals through Groupon.Discount offers have appeared for restaurants including Brixx, Vic’s Pizzeria, Chuck E. Cheese, Nancy’s Pizzeria, Rudino’s, Divano’s Pizzeria and Johnny’s Pizza.The offers were listed as available as of March 8, 2026, though customers are encouraged to check their specific zip code to see local deals.DoorDashDelivery platform DoorDash is also participating in the Pi Day celebration with several restaurant promotions.According to the DoorDash press release, “Customers nationwide can take advantage of the following Pi Day offers in the DoorDash app:”Pizza Hut customers can buy one medium or large “Create Your Own” pizza and receive another free on March 14 at participating locations.Sbarro is offering $4 off eligible orders of $20 or more between March 14 and April 6.Blaze Pizza is also running a promotion where customers who buy one Simple Pie 11-inch cheese pizza receive another free between March 14 and April 6.ALSO READ: Quote of the Day by Franz Kafka: 'Beyond a certain point there is no return. This point has…'— Top quotes by the Absurdist fiction novelistGrocery Store DealsRetailers are also participating in Pi Day with discounts on frozen pizzas and bakery pies.Food Lion is selling snack pies in the bakery section for $1 each between March 11 and March 17.The store is also offering Red Baron frozen pizzas for $4.49, with a $1.50 digital coupon bringing the price down to $2.99.Harris Teeter is selling flatbread pizzas for $3.14 on March 14 and has additional offers on gourmet pies and hot take-and-bake pizzas.Lidl is offering select Red Baron frozen pizzas for $3.49 between March 11 and March 17.Lowes Foods has bakery apple pies for $5.99, while Publix is selling small apple pies for $3.14.A holiday that blends math and foodPi Day may have started as a mathematical celebration, but it has grown into one of the most entertaining food holidays of the year.From pizza chains and convenience stores to grocery retailers and delivery apps, businesses are embracing the circular theme of the day.For customers, it simply means plenty of chances to enjoy pizza slices, dessert pies and other circular treats — often for the memorable price of $3.14.Happy Pi Day 2026!FAQsWhy is Pi Day celebrated on March 14?Pi Day is observed on March 14 because the date matches the number 3.14, the mathematical constant representing the ratio of a circle’s circumference to its diameter.Which restaurants are offering Pi Day deals in 2026?Several chains are participating, including Pizza Hut, Burger King, Blaze Pizza, Domino’s, Marco’s Pizza, MOD Pizza and others.
